title: 这轮IPO巨头云集：和90年代末不一样，但可能已走得更远？

segments.en: You've given us a mincement to the sweep of your career going back to O607 when you wrote this book What do you make of the of what we're seeing the fact that you have these IPOs that are so massive the numbers have gotten so

segments.en: I mean these anthropic got really big as a company that people get old company people give it lots of money And that wasn't quite true yet of all those companies going public at big valuations in the late 90s

segments.en: And that I mean on the one hand that means there's some more solidity here on the other hand It may mean that they're already much farther along in the journey. I just don't know um
